evidence.inputBinding: caller-supplied candidate values; producer, side, schedule and meaning require separately anchored harness binding

topology.scope: One real L512 candidate-validation run with actual a80 SDK light LOW +1 cross-Q4 rows/bias only; native rollback restored immutable base by exact byte checks.

export.scope: Explicit output export only. Base64 strings and protocol copies are real host allocations; their allocator peak and total copy traffic are unknown.

browserMemory.scope: Sampled owned Chromium process sums include harness/File/ORT/Hike; RSS counts shared pages repeatedly. PSS apportions shared pages. Cgroup includes the entire environment and memory.peak predates this run. Sampling can miss short peaks; neither is allocator usage or full-pipeline peak.

numericGates.rule: abs(actual-reference) <= abs + rel*abs(reference); all values, no percentile pass
